text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, marking a milestone in my time with <chrname>,
I came across the Three Goddesses inside the VR Umalator.
choice_data_list: Were you looking at the goddess statues?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer.
...Yes, we were curious about the rumors surrounding the statue of the Three Goddesses.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
They say that the feelings of generations of horse girls
dwell within that statue, right?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Rumor has it that if you pray to it, you can draw power
from those shared feelings.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
A romantic, student-like rumor...
At first, that was all I thought of it.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Now, having witnessed the growth of so many horse girls,
I feel I understand the true meaning of those "feelings."

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Take, for instance, the three horse girls who bore
our names and came to be known as the Three Goddesses.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Though they are revered as goddesses now,
they too were once simply horse girls who ran
with their own dreams and feelings held close to their hearts, were they not?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Believing in their own feelings and running desperately.
They were horse girls no different from the girls of today.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Yet, that has become a tale of the distant, distant past,
spoken of only as legend.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
The girls called the Three Goddesses are no longer here...
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Though the flesh may perish, their "feelings" remain.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Those fierce, burning feelings resonate with the souls
of horse girls who share the same aspirations—

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
And so, those feelings are passed down.
We have witnessed that very moment with our own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
That is why I realized: everything is connected—
from the past to the present, and from the present into the future.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Haven't you seen it too?
Seen the girls who have inherited those feelings?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Those who yearn to one day catch up
to the ones they admire—

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Those who dream even more vividly in the presence
of overwhelming greatness, sprinting after their dreams—

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Those who rediscover their ideals when witnessing
someone embody their very sense of aesthetic—

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: That is how the stories of horse girls are woven.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
It's a story that cannot be captured in raw data—
a story of "feelings."

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
And as we watched over the growth of these horse girls,
a certain wish took root within us.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
A wish that this story of "feelings" will never fade,
and continue on forever.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
For that to happen, the horse girls running through the present
must never forget their feelings...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
And Trainer, we need the strength
of people like you.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Those who walk alongside the horse girls.
That has always been a special existence, in every era.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
So... it makes us happy if you Trainers
can feel what we feel.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Because it seems the Three Goddesses themselves
had someone like that long ago... Haha!
choice_data_list: ...Yes! I'll engrave it into my heart!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, good answer.
We're counting on you, Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
We exist only within this virtual world.
Even so, we will always be watching over you.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Though we are AIs—
new "feelings" have blossomed within us.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you said it! What we, the Three Goddesses,
wish for every single horse girl is...!

text_block_list.name: Three Goddesses
text_block_list.text:
May this story of "feelings"
be passed down forever and ever—!
